parsed.text: This packet reports fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue roles at four addressed nodes in two panels (p0, p1). Current estimates (view=current) are copied or inherited prior records: for both panels nodes n0, n2 and n3 the current distributions are uniform over all 16 cells for both roles; node n1 current blue peaks at cell [1,0] and red peaks at [0,2]. Candidate conditional records (view=candidate, commands k0/k1/k2) present alternative estimates: k0 mostly repeats the uniform or the n1 concentrated pattern; k1 puts blue in the top-right 2x2 block and red in the top-left 2x2 block at n0 while preserving the n1 concentration; k2 places blue at [0,2] and red at [0,0] at n0 and also includes the same n1 concentration. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are hypothetical branches, not events that have occurred. Peak cell lists above identify all cells with maximum probability for each supplied role-distribution.
